'''Razorback Island''' was an island on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. During the [[Galactic War]], the [[Order of Revan]] constructed a large signal jammer on the island in order to block communications during the forthcoming [[Battle of Rishi]]; however, a team of independent operatives invaded the island and deactivated the jammer.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
